info.name: Report cards seen by the user

params.name: partner
params.description: The partner identification code issued by Dailyhunt at onboarding.

params.name: puid
params.description: The partner's unique id for the end user accessing the API (for example a device identifier). Dailyhunt maps it to an internal user id to personalize the feed.

params.name: ts
params.description: Current client timestamp in milliseconds; must be included in the signed parameter set.

items.docs: Reports the cards a user actually saw. The partner posts an array of `{id, trackData}` pairs (the `trackData` value comes verbatim from the card in the Content Fetch response) together with the view timestamp. Callers should POST to the `trackUrl` returned by the Content Fetch API, appending `partner`, `puid` and `ts`, once per list view.
